title: 第1314章 只要你死第1313章 时间紧迫
content_zh:
平台上只剩下陈平一个人！
他站在青石地面的正中央，环视四周。
灰蒙蒙的天空依旧压在头顶，枯死的山峦依旧横亘在远方，干涸的河道依旧散发着腐朽的气味。
然后深吸一口气。
生死处境，他不知已经遇到了多少次。
紫府期被金丹追杀，金丹期被元婴盯上，秘境里被空间裂缝吞噬……
每一次都是险死还生，但他每一次都活下来了。
区区几句话就想击垮他的道心，那是不可能的。
"未来的事，谁又说得准。"
陈平自言自语了一句，语气平淡，像在说今天的天气不太好。
催动婴元，脚底喷出一团淡金色光芒，整个人化为一道青色遁光，冲入灰蒙蒙的天空。
陈平的遁光速度快到极致，青色的光芒在灰暗的天空中划出一道笔直的轨迹。
从高空俯瞰，小世界的全貌逐渐清晰。
八处节点组成一个巨大的圆形阵势，阵势的正中央有一团暗红色光芒，暗红色光芒在不断膨胀收缩。
祭献阵法已经启动了一部分。
陈平的脸色沉下来。
他的元神捕捉到了更多的细节……
各个方向都有修士在朝八处节点靠近，他们以为那里有机缘，有宝物，有传承。
韩道人的局，确实周密。
每个步骤都没有问题。

用真实的机缘做诱饵，用复杂的阵法布置做陷阱，用假消息吸引目标人群，最后将所有知情者一网打尽。
如果对手不是陈平，如果这个世界不是早就被另一个存在占据了，韩道人这次的局可能真的能成。
阵眼位置长着一株通体翠绿的灵芝，灵芝顶端的伞盖散发着淡淡的灵光。
那株灵芝是太虚灵芝，化神丹的三种主药之一。
陈平看到太虚灵芝的瞬间，心里反而踏实了几分。
韩道人没有在关键信息上造假，化神丹主药确实在虚天殿遗址里。
洞穴入口不大，高约三丈，宽约两丈，洞口两侧的石壁上生长着暗紫色的苔藓，苔藓在黑暗中发出幽幽的荧光。
洞口深处，有一股浓郁的灵药气息飘出来。
灵药的气息清澈纯净，和这个灰暗压抑的小世界格格不入。
陈平落在洞口前，双脚踩在地面上，脚下的泥土松软潮湿，踩上去发出轻微的噗叽声。
他迈步走入洞穴。
洞穴内部的空间比外面看起来要大，洞壁上镶嵌着夜明珠，每隔三步一颗，排列整齐。
夜明珠的光芒柔和均匀，照亮了整条通道。
content_en:
Chen Ping is the only one left on the platform!
He stood in the middle of the bluestone floor and looked around.
The gray sky still hangs overhead, the dead mountains still lie in the distance, and the dry rivers still exude the smell of decay.
Then take a deep breath.
He didn't know how many times he had encountered life and death situations.
In the Zifu period, he was chased by Jindan, and in the Jindan period, he was targeted by Nascent Soul, and the secret realm was swallowed up by space cracks...
It was a close call every time, but he survived every time.
It's impossible to break his Taoist heart with just a few words.
"No one can say for sure what will happen in the future."
Chen Ping muttered to himself, his tone was calm, as if he was saying that the weather today was not very good.
Actuating the Ying Yuan, a ball of light golden light erupted from the soles of his feet, and his whole body turned into a blue escaping light, rushing into the gray sky.
Chen Ping's light escape speed was extremely fast, and the cyan light drew a straight trajectory in the gray sky.
Viewed from a high altitude, the whole picture of the small world gradually becomes clear.
Eight nodes formed a huge circular formation, and there was a dark red light in the center of the formation. The dark red light was constantly expanding and contracting.
The sacrifice formation has been partially activated.
Chen Ping's face darkened.
His soul captured more details...
There are monks from all directions approaching the eight nodes. They think there are opportunities, treasures and inheritance there.
Daoren Han's plan is indeed thorough.
No problem every step of the way.
Use real opportunities as bait, use complex formations as traps, use false news to attract target people, and finally catch all the insiders.
If the opponent hadn't been Chen Ping, if the world hadn't been occupied by another existence for a long time, Han Daoren might have succeeded this time.
There is an emerald-green Ganoderma lucidum growing at the center of the formation, and the umbrella cover at the top of the Ganoderma lucidum exudes a faint aura.
That Ganoderma lucidum is Taixu Ganoderma, one of the three main herbs in the Transformation Pill.
The moment Chen Ping saw Taixu Ganoderma, he felt a little more at ease.
Taoist Han did not falsify any key information, and the main ingredient of the God Transformation Pill was indeed in the ruins of Xutian Palace.
The entrance to the cave is not large, about three feet high and two feet wide. Dark purple moss grows on the stone walls on both sides of the cave entrance, and the moss emits a faint fluorescence in the darkness.
Deep inside the cave entrance, a strong scent of elixir wafted out.
The breath of the elixir is clear and pure, and is incompatible with this dark and depressing little world.
Chen Ping landed in front of the cave entrance and stepped on the ground with his feet. The soil under his feet was soft and wet, making a slight squelching sound when he stepped on it.
He stepped into the cave.
The space inside the cave is larger than it looks from the outside. The cave walls are inlaid with luminous pearls, one every three steps, arranged neatly.
The light of the luminous pearl is soft and even, illuminating the entire passage.
